prompt: Create a vertical storybook paper-cut diorama illustration in warm autumn light: a tiny golden-brown hamster stands at the threshold of an arched doorway made from exactly 3 oversized maple leaves, counted as 1 muted green left leaf, 1 tall ochre center leaf forming the peak, and 1 golden-orange right leaf. The hamster, a small fluffy hamster, is seen from behind in three-quarter view, with round ears, black bead eye, tiny paws lifted, soft fur, and a small white tail, gazing into a glowing miniature autumn forest. Inside the leaf arch, show exactly 1 winding leaf-covered path, 2 dark tree trunks framing the sides, layered orange hills in the distance, and several falling maple leaves silhouetted against a bright sunset sky. Outside the doorway, use a matte sage-green paper-textured background and floor, with botanical cut-paper decorations around the frame: exactly 2 tall leafy sprigs on the left side and exactly 2 tall leafy sprigs on the right side, plus scattered flat autumn leaves on the ground. The whole scene should feel handmade from textured paper, with visible leaf veins, embossed fibers, soft shadows, warm golden light streaming out of the doorway, and a long cast shadow from the hamster across the foreground. Use a cozy seasonal palette of sage green, ochre, amber, burnt orange, and soft gold. No text, no watermark, no photorealistic plastic look; keep it whimsical, tactile, softly cinematic, and centered.

promptZh: 创作一张垂直的绘本风格纸艺立体透视插画，呈现温暖的秋日光影：一只小巧的棕金色仓鼠站在拱形门槛前，拱门由 3 片巨大的枫叶组成，具体为：左侧 1 片柔和的绿色叶子，中间 1 片高耸的赭色叶子构成顶峰，右侧 1 片金橙色叶子。这只仓鼠 一只毛茸茸的小仓鼠 以四分之三侧背影呈现，圆耳朵、黑豆般的眼睛、小爪子微微抬起，毛发柔软，有着白色的小尾巴，正凝视着发光的微缩秋季森林。在叶片拱门内，展示 1 条蜿蜒的落叶小径，两侧由 2 棵深色树干环绕，远处是层叠的橙色山丘，几片飘落的枫叶在明亮的夕阳天空下呈现剪影。门外使用哑光鼠尾草绿色的纸质背景和地面，边框周围装饰着植物剪纸：左侧 2 枝高大的叶片枝条，右侧 2 枝高大的叶片枝条，地面上散落着平铺的秋叶。整个场景应呈现出手工制作的纹理纸质感，可见叶脉、压纹纤维、柔和的阴影，温暖的金色光芒从门内流淌而出，仓鼠在前景投下长长的影子。使用 鼠尾草绿、赭色、琥珀色、焦橙色和柔金色 的温馨季节配色。无文字，无水印，避免写实塑料感；保持奇幻、触感真实、柔和电影感，且构图居中。
